screen.volatility_formula: sample_std(close_t/close_tminus1-1 over current20)*sqrt(252); 21 consecutive positive finite closes; excludes corporate action adjustment
screen.listing_age_rule: calendar open sessions since listing effective_from; start clipped to 2019 for older listings, guaranteed >=120 before first decision
screen.next_open_rule: next open calendar_session joined by venue; valid listing/security [from,to), positive finite open, tradable and can_buy true, positive finite upper limit, open < upper-0.005
screen.unknown_rule: missing/invalid required input blocks admission; disjoint ordered reason ledger
screen.control: same decision dates and listing universe; positive finite close and current tradability; no candidate filters

decision.consumer: R2 task allocator; first decide whether execution-guard investigation outranks a signal screen; retain existing P2 execution constraints

branches.invalid: stop and preserve attempt; no new market conclusion
branches.insufficient: inconclusive, park without expanding data or tuning
branches.small: retain existing guards and prioritize one concrete signal question; no ideal-fill waiver

exposure.recompute_reason: One located correction: failed screen outputs must not be reused as a successful retry. A3 preserved; A4 binds corrected code. Same SQL, thresholds and 56 input members; this is the final corrected acceptance canary.
